case.title: Midnight Masquerade
case.introduction: A glittering charity gala is underway at the opulent Villa Aurora. Amid champagne and music, the priceless Blue Orchid necklace is to be unveiled, but when the lights dim, the jewel vanishes, and suspicion falls on everyone present.
case.crime: The priceless Blue Orchid necklace is stolen during the gala unveiling.
case.target_fake_identity: Sophia Laurent, the charity gala coordinator
case.escape_plan: The culprit slips out through the service elevator after swapping the necklace with a replica, then boards a waiting car in the villa's underground garage.

rooms.name: Ballroom
rooms.description: Grand hall with crystal chandeliers, where the Blue Orchid is displayed on a velvet pedestal.

rooms.description: Cozy room lined with books, where Dr. Hale gives his talk.

rooms.name: Garden Terrace
rooms.description: Open terrace with marble statues and a sea view, used for a cocktail hour.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: Bustling area behind the scenes where catering staff prepares dishes.

characters.name: Lord Adrian Whitmore
characters.background: Owner of Villa Aurora, hosts charity gala to raise funds for the arts.
characters.secret: He once used his influence to hide a scandalous affair.
characters.goal: Ensure the gala runs flawlessly and raise a record amount.
characters.alibi: Was greeting guests in the Ballroom.

Isla serves as his personal assistant.

characters.name: Sophia Laurent
characters.background: Hired to organize the event, appears to have connections in high society.
characters.secret: She is Evelyn Drake, a notorious jewel thief, assuming this identity.
characters.goal: Steal the Blue Orchid and sell it on the black market.
characters.alibi: Was overseeing the kitchen staff during the time of theft.
knowledge: knows the exact time the necklace will be displayed
lies: insists she was in the kitchen the whole time

characters.name: Dr. Marcus Hale
characters.background: Invited as expert speaker on historical jewels.
characters.secret: He once replaced a museum piece with a replica.
characters.alibi: Was delivering his lecture in the Library.
knowledge: knows details about the Blue Orchid's provenance
lies: claims he never touched the necklace

characters.name: Isla Moreno
characters.background: Works for Lord Whitmore, handles schedules.
characters.secret: She is deeply in debt to a loan shark.
characters.alibi: Was tending the garden terrace, arranging flowers.
knowledge: knows the schedule of the gala
lies: says she never saw anyone near the safe

transcript.speaker: Verdict
transcript.text: Your accusation rings out, but the truth shatters it like glass—Dr. Marcus Hale steps back, bewildered, as the real mastermind steps from the shadows. The hidden target, masquerading flawlessly as Sophia Laurent, smiles coldly, her carefully forged alibi crumbling under the weight of the evidence you missed. In the flicker of the dying lights, you realize the case slips through your fingers, and the true culprit vanishes into the night, leaving only the echo of your misstep.
